أستنقص (form X)
# أَسْتَنْقِصُ (ʔastanqiṣu) /ʔas.tan.qi.sˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْقَصَ (istanqaṣa)
# أَسْتَنْقِصَ (ʔastanqiṣa) /ʔas.tan.qi.sˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْقَصَ (istanqaṣa)
# أَسْتَنْقِصْ (ʔastanqiṣ) /ʔas.tan.qisˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْقَصَ (istanqaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
